Thanks Elena — summarizing a compact activation plan (v0.1) below. I'm happy to iterate in a quick call tomorrow if you prefer.

Activation Eval Sentry — v0.1 (high-level)
1) Prompt & Eval Set handoff
  - BrightLeaf provides prompt-sets_v0.csv (columns: id, prompt, expected_output_pattern, severity).
  - Owner: BrightLeaf (deliver) / Marissa (Redwood intake).
2) Eval harness integration (staging)
  - Redwood will onboard the prompt set into our eval harness (Jenkins -> eval-runner) and run baseline metrics (accuracy, ROC, token-level diff).
  - Config: eval-harness-config.yaml (attached sample).
  - Owner: Rishi (integration), Monica (CS validation).
3) Canary plan (staging -> pilot)
  - Canary window: 48 hours with 5% of production traffic directed to the new model/config.
  - Canary metrics: degradation > 3% absolute on accuracy OR > 7% increase in high-severity failures triggers rollback.
  - Automated rollback: if thresholds hit for 3 consecutive 10-minute buckets, traffic is reverted and PagerDuty alerted.
  - Owner: SRE (BrightLeaf) + Redwood on-call (Grace).
4) Regression alerts & dashboards
  - Real-time alerts (Slack + PagerDuty) for threshold breaches; weekly regression digest for Product.
  - Baseline stored and archived for audit.
5) Rollout & post-mortem
  - If canary passes, gradual ramp to 50% over next 24 hours, then 100% after 72 hours of stability.
  - If rollback happens, we capture eval traces, prompt failures, and propose remediation within 48 hours.

Attachments: prompt-sets_v0.csv (schema sample), eval-harness-config.yaml (sample), canary-checklist.pdf (ops checklist).

Next steps
- Elena: confirm CSV schema and SRE contact for canary ownership (cc your SRE).
- Rishi/Monica: confirm the staging integration ETA (target: Jun 14).
- Lauren: schedule a 30-min canary planning call for Jun 15.

Quick technical clarifications from the runtime side so we have a clean staging rollout: 
1) Eval harness config
  - The attached eval-harness-config.yaml uses model_alias: "redwood/llama-3b-quant" as a placeholder. Elena, do you want us to point the canary at a model variant with 8-bit quantization (faster, cheaper) or a full-precision variant to match your on-prem dev baseline?
2) Prompt context & KV cache
  - For prompts that are multi-turn, please indicate whether we should persist KV cache between calls (helps stateful agents but affects memory). Add column "session_persist" in the CSV if so.
3) Failure tracing
  - We'll include token-level diffs in the eval artifacts but need your approval to retain full request traces for 30 days for debugging (we mask PHI).

I can target the staging integration (dry-run) on Jun 14 morning if Marissa confirms the prompt CSV arrives by EOD Jun 13.

Attachment referenced: eval-harness-config.yaml
